{{Spoiler}} {{NPC Infobox |name = Balanophora |image = NPC Balanophora.png|Disguise ("Intendant of Sentinel Affairs") |nation = Huanglong |age = >200 |title = |title2 = |title3 = |alias = "Woman in Red" (by Muyu) |alias2 = Intendant of Sentinel Affairs |alias3 = |alias4 = |alias5 = |type = Quest |type2 = Resonator |affiliation = Fractsidus |affiliation2 = Ministry of Sentinel Affairs |affiliationNote2 = formerly }} {{Description|''Turbulent times demand a resolute heart.''|Balanophora, [[Simulacrum of the Heart]]}} '''Balanophora''' {{Lang|zh=蛇菰}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who is first mentioned during [[Song of the Heart Sword]], and makes her first appearance during {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}. She is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]], and is the overarching antagonist of [[Chapter IV|Chapter IV:]] [[Chapter IV|Rebirth From the Depths]]. ==Profile== Balanophora is the "woman in red" referenced by [[Muyu]] that pulled the strings of the Autopuppet Crisis from afar. According to Muyu, Balanophora wanted to take Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule.{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} Dialogue: :'''Muyu:''' Do not misunderstand. The [[Hsin|Sentinel's]] knowledge is my only concern. The one who wanted this Capsule? Ask your old enemy. [[Xuanfang]] is but one corner of the chaos in [[Mengzhou]]. :'''Muyu:''' Unfortunately, I have no interest in '''Balanophora's''' petty schemes. :'''(‍Rover‍):''' So she's the "woman in red" you mentioned before? A [[Fractsidus]] Overseer? She spent years undercover as a Ministry Intendant, backstabbed Sentinel [[Hsin]] the Moon Fox and assassinated her. The Sentinel split off a Fractal Form known simply as "Hsin" in the crisis. ==Story== ===History=== Balanophora's origins remain shrouded in mystery. ====Infiltrating the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs==== At some point in the distant past, over 200 years ago, she infiltrated and posed as an Intendant of the [[Ministry of Sentinel Affairs]], as a means of getting close to Sentinel [[Hsin]] and her Civilization Capsule's technology for the [[Fractsidus]]. Hsin later summoned a meeting at [[Mengzhou]]'s City Hall to deliberate between [[Zhuojun Atelier]] and the [[Court of Savantae]] over which of the two would construct [[Xuanfang Hold]]. Balanophora was present at the summoning in disguise, where she helped magistrate the meeting at Hsin's side, before Hsin ultimately selected the Court of Savantae to be the future Xuanfang Hold's builders. After the conclusion of the meeting, Balanophora pulled Hsin aside to relay her doubts, questioning Zhoujun Atelier's self-serving, untrustworthy nature, and telling Hsin that she believed their lack of loyalties made them a liability. Hsin disagreed, arguing that the Court were the more dangerous of the two due to their relentless obsession with the pursuit of knowledge, and that reigning this ideology in at arm's length was her primary motive for selecting them to be Xuanfang Hold's architects, as she believed they would preserve it at all costs, granting them their "final wish" to sacrifice themselves to build the hold. ====Assassinating Hsin==== Later that evening, she accompanied the Sentinel back to her quarters. She praised the Sentinel's decision as one that would lift the spirits of the Mengzhou border troops, advising her to "pay no mind to the occasional objections," and encouraging her to be resolute in her decision. Caught unawares after settling, Balanophora unsheathed a hidden blade concealed within her hairpin, seizing the moment to quickly assassinate Hsin from behind. This later lead to the damaging and sabotage of her Civilization Capsule by the Fractsidus, while the original Hsin survived but was left in a critically injured state, forcing her to split her essence into the fractal form that became her eventual successor, who quickly fled with the Civilization Capsule in fox form to save it from the Fractsidus. According to [[Suoming]], Hsin's assassination also coincided with the later emergence of the mysterious [[Waveworn Phenomenon]] known as the Evil Miasma.{{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}} Skip Summary: :'''Summary:''' Through [[Hsin|"Hsin's"]] eyes, you glimpse the truth of what happened at the [[Ministry of Sentinel Affairs|Ministry's]] council. The Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, is assassinated. The killer is '''Balanophora''', a Ministry Intendant who spent years undercover waiting for this moment. In the crisis, Hsin splits off a Fractal Form. As the shadows close in, a newborn fox flees with the Civilization Capsule. Long afterwards, Balanophora's actions eventually led to the original Hsin being too weak to survive the inadvertent draining of her energy by her fractal form's remolding of the Civilization Capsule beyond the Hold's intended collapse, leading to her death. ====Working With Muyu==== Over two centuries later, she temporarily allied herself with [[Muyu]] in the modern era, using him as a means to find another opportunity to steal Hsin's civilization capsule by infiltrating the Xuanyuan Domain. Muyu brought [[Xuanfang Hold]] close to the brink, but ultimately met his defeat at the hands of [[Rover]] and [[Qingxiao]] within the Xuanyuan Domain's Tian Realm. Muyu was cornered at the end of the fight, where he unapologetically admitted his ties to Balanophora after failing to kill the duo with his newly-created [[Calamity Effigy]] shell that was possessed by him, before being struck down. Some time afterwards, he later attempted to escape in secrecy with one of Hsin's data cores by transferring his Reverberation into a frail Autopuppet shell. However, he was found and killed by [[Jingran]], who sought revenge for Muyu's murder of his parents; Having earlier pretended to ally with Muyu to get in close proximity before betraying him. Ultimately, Muyu failed to procure the Civilization Capsule for Balanophora, causing her to suffer yet another setback in her conspiracy to seize the Capsule. Following Muyu's death, her current whereabouts remain unknown. Balanophora was disavowed in the aftermath by the [[Flowerveil Puppet]] upon [[Suisui]]'s investigation into Muyu's ties to her, who denied [[Zhuojun Atelier]] having ties to the Fractsidus, claiming that Muyu's alliance with Balanophora was merely a technology trading partnership that ended years ago, despite evidence from logs left behind by Muyu that showed otherwise, along with his own final testimony to Rover and Qingxiao.{{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} =====Communication Log===== Encountered during {{Quest|Song of the Heart Sword}} :{{Description|'''Gentle Female Voice:''' As you requested, ████ has fallen into isolation.

'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Nothing stands between you and your plans now, but don't forget our agreement.

'''Stern Male Voice:''' Sure, ████ is yours.

'''Stern Male Voice:''' But only after I've obtained the ██ inside of it.

'''Gentle Female Voice:''' Very well, I'll be waiting.

'''Gentle Female Voice:''' So it seems... you are no different from the [[Court of Savantae]] after all.|title=A Damaged Communication Log}} ==Appearance== Balanophora is a fair-skinned, slim woman with an angular face, dark black straight hair, and azure blue eyes. In her guise as a Sentinel Affairs Intendant, she kept her hair styled in a chin-length bob-cut, which she kept tied back, with her face being sharply framed by her bangs. Her most visually striking feature are the snake-like scales along the left side of her face. She physically appears to at least be middle-aged, judging by the wrinkles under her eyes, which give her a weary appearance. Though as Hsin noted, she had gone without sleep for 3 days at this point, so these may also simply be eye bags. Balanophora's true appearance remains unknown. ===Clothing=== As the Intendant of Sentinel Affairs, she wore a standard-issue Intendant uniform to maintain her guise. She wore a black, wide-sleeved jacket with black wrist-length gloves, layered over a crisp white high-collared blouse with dark gold regalia styling her overcoat and undershirt. The jacket itself is embroidered with traditional Chinese-inspired fox emblems that are braided along the jacket, including an ornamental fox pin on the left side of the coat. The jacket extends into a frock coat hanging over the sides of each leg. The uniform has a red pouch sashed at its hip. ==Personality== Little is known about Balanophora's true personality, beyond glimpses from her actions and comments made while in her disguise at the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. Judging from her campaign against Hsin, Balanophora has had a centuries-long obsession with capturing the Mengzhou civilization capsule, to the point of political subterfuge. Similar to how her peers in the [[Fractsidus]] have acted, namely her [[Schwarzloch|superior]] and [[Cristoforo]], she will not hesitate to resort to infiltration in order to get close to her targets or those she seeks to influence with a disturbing level of patience and commitment, as the Intendant role in the Ministry is notably one of its highest-ranking roles, both in the organization, and by extension the greater [[Huanglong]] political sphere. This is also shown in her successor [[Suoming]]'s chain of command over the Ministry's representatives and agents. She is also fiercely opportunistic and manipulative, even going as far as to engage in civil conspiracy and sabotage by manipulating [[Muyu]], exploiting his drive to steal Hsin's knowledge for her own benefit in capturing the Civilization Capsule. In the past, she also quickly seized the chance to remove the original Hsin from the board just before she could use the Civilization Capsule to construct Xuanfang Hold, once they were isolated and alone together, having flawlessly played her role just to work towards this moment for an unknown amount of years beforehand, showcasing a strong degree of cunning. As the Intendant, she retained an air of paranoia, suspicion, and hypervigilance around Hsin, particularly shown by her distrust of [[Zhuojun Atelier]]'s selfish ambitions. In some of her final words to Hsin before murdering her, she briefly encouraged her to act decisively, while ignoring the disagreements of the people regarding her choice for the [[Court of Savantae]] to build [[Xuanfang Hold]], implying she may be an Overseer that values faith and dedication to one's goals, and steadfast commitment over paying mind to the perspectives of her subordinates. ==Resonance== Like other [[Fractsidus]] Overseers, she is a [[Resonator]], though her Tacet Mark and Forte remain unseen. Her namesake being a parasitic plant that deprives other plants' roots of sustenance suggests that her powers may involve a form of parasitism, and the ability to seed her influence in others. Whether her Forte empowered the hairpin she used to assassinate Hsin, or was some form of anti-Sentinel weapon, currently remains unknown. Her snake-like facial scales suggest that her Forte may also potentially involve poison. ==Quests and Events== {{Quests and Events}} ==Trivia== *During the part where Balanophora is about to assassinate Sentinel Hsin, there are a bunch of scenes flashing on the screen within 2 seconds. These scenes include the Fractsidus Overseers [[Cristoforo]] and [[Phrolova]], which implies that the Sentinel's assassination is connected to Fractsidus, and that the "Intendant of Sentinel Affairs" was associated with them. **This is confirmed by the skip summary mentioning her to be Balanophora. *The snake scales on Balanophora's face may reference the Chinese translation of her name, which literally translates to "蛇菰 (shé gū)", or "snake-fungus." In-universe, this may be a physical trait of her Resonator mutation. **Her actions may have additional parallels, due to her namesake's nature as a parasitic plant that burrows underground and attaches itself to roots to derive water and nutrients, which mirrors her deep infiltration of the Ministry's ranks and corruption of Hsin's Civilization Capsule. *As of her debut, Balanophora is technically the first human character to physically kill a [[Sentinel]] onscreen, having been the cause of the original Hsin's inability to survive her later frequency loss to her successor's remolding of the Civilization Capsule, despite the assassination attempt initially failing. ===Etymology=== *Balanophora is named after [[wp:Balanophora|the genus of parasitic flowering plants]]. ==Gallery== File:NPC Balanophora Fullbody.png|Full Body ''(as the Intendant of Sentinel Affairs)'' File:NPC Balanophora Scales.png|Balanophora's scales up close File:NPC Balanophora2.png|Balanophora standing before the [[Court of Savantae]] and [[Zhuojun Atelier]] ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Balanophora |zhs = 蛇菰 |zht = 蛇菰 |ja = {{Rubi|蛇菰|ダコ}} |ko = 사고(蛇菰) |fr = Balanophora |de = Balanophora |es = Balanophora |th = Balanophora |pt = Balanophora }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==References== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Huanglong NPCs]]
